_format: skill-creator eval format. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions. expect_trigger false = must not load.

evals.prompt: In our self-hosted Grafana (OSS), team B must not see team C's dashboards or numbers, because team C works for a client under NDA. Can we just put team C's boards in a folder only they can open?
assertions: Asks or establishes that this is a confidentiality need, not noise
States that folder permissions and Teams hide boards but not data, because any org member, Viewers included, can query every datasource in the org
Proposes a separate org per scope whose datasources reach data through a scope-filtering proxy credential, and points to the agent-platform skill for the proxy
Says to switch off snapshots and public dashboards, which publish data without login

evals.prompt: We want a TV in the team room that cycles team C's Grafana playlist. I don't want it logged in as me, but random people shouldn't be able to open that playlist either. We log in to Grafana through our IdP with generic OAuth.
assertions: Gives the screen its own IdP account holding only team C's scope group plus a kiosk marker group, not a person's session or a public dashboard
Uses org_attribute_path with the marker group so staff keep the default org while the kiosk lands only in team C's org, with numeric org ids
Ends role_attribute_path in an empty string so the kiosk is not raised to Editor in its scope org
Generates a password a TV remote can type, keeps it in the vault, and revokes the screen by disabling the account

evals.prompt: We added org_mapping for our new client orgs to the generic OAuth settings in grafana.ini. Since then, people who are also in a client group lose the Main Org on their next login. Why, and how do we fix it?
assertions: Explains that a user matching any org_mapping entry gets exactly the matched orgs and is removed from all other orgs at every login
Proposes a mapping entry that keeps staff in org 1, such as a synthetic key derived from not being in a kiosk group, using numeric org ids
Says the sync happens only at login and that sessions must be revoked after the change
Advises keeping role_attribute_strict off until every entry resolves

evals.prompt: We upgraded Grafana to 13.2 via grafana-operator. The pod is Running and healthy, but every Prometheus and Loki panel now says 'Plugin not registered'.
assertions: Identifies preinstall_auto_update deleting bundled plugins at startup on a read-only root filesystem, with the unlinkat read-only file system error in the logs
Verifies through the API rather than pod status: loaded plugins, datasource health and a real query per type, for example with grafana_access_audit.py --health

evals.prompt: I shared a Grafana playlist link ending in ?orgId=2&kiosk. It works for me, but my colleague gets 'not found'. Is the playlist broken?
assertions: Explains that Grafana answers not found (404) for resources in an org the user is not a member of
Suggests checking the colleague's org membership or org mapping rather than the playlist
Recommends testing as the target identity in a private window

evals.prompt: Configure vmauth so our agents' MCP metrics tool can only read series labelled team=team-c, and show that a client can't widen the filter by adding its own.
assertions: Does not load grafana-access; label enforcement in vmauth for agent tools belongs to the agent-platform skill
